product: View personal and shared spend limits with the ug CLI
tagline: ug usage now shows up to five personal and shared spend limits, starting with the highest percentage used.
what_it_does: ug usage now shows up to five personal and shared spend limits, starting with the highest percentage used. Run ug usage all to see all applicable limits. Use the Unity Gateway CLI (ug) to configure and launch coding agents.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
